page: Microsoft Azure M416s_6_v3 is an ultra-high-capacity memory-optimized virtual machine from the MSHighMemoryv3 family, driven by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server utilizes the x86_64 Intel processor architecture to deliver 416 dedicated vCPUs alongside an extensive 5696.0 GB system memory allocation. This architecture yields a dense memory-to-vCPU allocation of approximately 13.69 GB per core, accommodating massive transactional datasets that require low-latency resident memory access across hundreds of concurrent compute threads.

The hardware configuration omits local ephemeral disks, presenting no integrated local storage. Instead, the virtual machine relies entirely on remote storage, utilizing its Premium Storage capability to manage disk operations and persistent volumes over network interfaces. There are zero discrete graphics processing units bundled with the instance, focusing all underlying host resources directly on primary compute and memory tasks. Additionally, the instance provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default, necessitating structured virtual network setups.

From a cost efficiency and resource utilization perspective, the instance consolidates large enterprise deployments that would otherwise require expansive distributed clusters. Eliminating local disks mitigates node maintenance overhead but necessitates sufficient network storage bandwidth for logging and snapshots. The platform is engineered specifically for massive in-memory databases, large-scale SAP HANA production workloads, real-time corporate data warehousing, and heavy enterprise transaction processing engines.
description: Microsoft Azure M416s_6_v3 is an ultra-high-capacity memory-optimized instance in the MSHighMemoryv3 family, operated on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel architecture, it provides 416 dedicated vCPUs and 5696.0 GB of system memory, which yields an allocation ratio of 13.69 GB per virtual CPU. The instance provides no bundled local storage, requiring remote Premium Storage connectivity for operating system files and data volumes, and includes no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Without complimentary public IPv4 networking out of the box, access is maintained via standard cloud network routing. The architecture is suited for consolidating massive enterprise workloads that require extensive memory density, such as multi-terabyte in-memory transactional databases, SAP HANA deployments, and high-concurrency real-time operational analytics engines.
